numSeqScans.description: Number of sequential scans initiated on this table.

numSeqTupFetched.description: Number of live rows fetched by sequential scans.

numIndexScans.description: Number of index scans initiated on this index.

numTupFetched.description: Number of live rows fetched by index scans.

numTupHotUpd.description: Number of rows HOT updated (i.e., with no separate index update required).

numHeapBlksRead.description: Number of disk blocks read from this table.

numHeapBlksHit.description: Number of buffer hits in this table.

numIndxBlksRead.description: Number of disk blocks read from all indexes on this table.

numIndxBlksHit.description: Number of buffer hits in all indexes on this table.

numToastBlksRead.description: Number of disk blocks read from this table's TOAST table (if any).

numToastBlksHit.description: Number of buffer hits in this table's TOAST table (if any).

numToastIndxBlksRead.description: Number of disk blocks read from this table's TOAST table index (if any).

numToastIndxBlksHit.description: Number of buffer hits in this table's TOAST table index (if any).
